title: 缝制设备发展趋势
Trends in Sewing Equipment
goals: 能由台数、开机时间和两种电机的平均功率算出伺服直驱改造的年节电量、减排量和投资回收期。
Calculate the annual electricity saving, emission reduction and payback of a direct-drive servo retrofit from machine count, running hours and the average powers of the two motors.
能用 B = w c³ 由克重和弯曲长度算出面料弯曲刚度，并用推布失稳公式解释布为什么“推不动、立不住”。
Calculate fabric bending rigidity from mass per unit area and bending length with B = w c³, and use the push-buckling formula to explain why cloth cannot be pushed or stand up.
能用 P = pⁿ 算出机器人多步流程的无人完成率和每小时人工干预次数，并估算回收期。
Use P = pⁿ to calculate the unattended completion rate and hourly human interventions of a multi-step robot flow, and estimate its payback.
能用数字互相核对的方法判断新技术报道是否可信，并说明焊接、粘合、全成型等“不缝”工艺的适用范围。
Judge the credibility of reports on new technology by cross-checking their numbers, and state where 'no-sew' processes such as welding, bonding and whole-garment knitting apply.

title: 机器人上料：供应商说成功率 97%，值不值？
Robot loading: the vendor says 97% success — is it worth it?
text: 一家衬衫厂考虑用机器人把裁片从料堆送到缝纫机上：分离布片、提起、铺平、对位、上料等共 10 个动作，每个动作 8 s，供应商给出单步成功率 97%。每次失败要人花 30 s 处理，再重做这一步。机器人 25 万元，年维护费为价格的 10%，顶替每班一名操作工，两班制，每年 300 天，人工 0.5 元/分（含社保和管理费用）。

A shirt factory is considering a robot to take cut pieces from the stack to the sewing machine: separating the ply, lifting, smoothing, aligning and loading — 10 motions in all, 8 s each — with a vendor-quoted single-step success rate of 97%. Each failure takes a person 30 s to handle before the step is redone. The robot costs 250 000 yuan, annual maintenance is 10% of the price, it replaces one operator per shift, the factory runs two shifts for 300 days a year, and labour costs 0.5 yuan/min including social insurance and overheads.
question: 整条流程无人完成的概率是多少？每小时要人插手几次？投资回收期多长？要让 10 步流程 90% 无人完成，单步成功率要多少？

What is the probability that the whole flow completes without a person? How many times an hour must someone intervene? What is the payback period? What single-step success rate is needed for the 10-step flow to complete unattended 90% of the time?
answer: P = 0.97¹⁰ ≈ 74%，每 4 件约有 1 件要人处理；每件期望失败 10 × 0.03 ÷ 0.97 ≈ 0.31 次，节拍约 92 s，每小时约 39 件、人工干预约 12 次。年省人工 2 × 0.5 × 60 × 8 × 300 = 14.4 万元，扣除处理失败约 1.5 万元和维护 2.5 万元，回收期约 29 个月；改三班约 18 个月。要 90% 无人完成，单步须约 99%（0.9 的十分之一次方 ≈ 0.9895），此时干预降到每小时约 4 次，两班回收期约 26 个月。

P = 0.97¹⁰ ≈ 74%: about one piece in four needs a person. Expected failures per piece 10 × 0.03 ÷ 0.97 ≈ 0.31, cycle about 92 s, about 39 pieces and 12 interventions per hour. Labour saved 2 × 0.5 × 60 × 8 × 300 = 144 000 yuan a year; minus about 15 000 for handling failures and 25 000 maintenance, payback is about 29 months, or about 18 months on three shifts. For 90% unattended completion each step needs about 99% (the tenth root of 0.9 ≈ 0.9895); interventions then fall to about 4 an hour and two-shift payback to about 26 months.

title: 机器人插线缆：为什么要夹在线头附近
Robotic cable insertion: why grip near the tip
text: 推布失稳公式 F_cr = π²Bb/(4L²) 与机器人装配线束、软管时遇到的问题完全相同：机械手把导线推进连接器，悬空的那段导线就是一根一端夹住的细压杆。临界力与悬空长度的平方成反比，夹持点离线头近一半，能推的力就大四倍，所以线束装配机器人总是夹在线头附近、分几次短行程推进，或者改成拉的方式。多步上料流程的 pⁿ 规律也同样适用于工业机器人的料框抓取（bin picking）：识别、抓取、姿态校正、放置每一步的成功率相乘，才是整条节拍不停线的概率。

The push-buckling formula F_cr = π²Bb/(4L²) is exactly the problem robots meet when assembling wire harnesses and hoses: pushing a wire into a connector, the free length of wire is a slender column clamped at one end. The critical force is inversely proportional to the square of the free length, so gripping at half the distance from the tip allows four times the push; harness-assembly robots therefore grip close to the tip and insert in several short strokes, or pull instead. The pⁿ rule for multi-step loading applies equally to industrial bin picking: the success rates of recognition, grasping, pose correction and placement multiply to give the chance of a cycle with no stop.

title: 推不动的绳子
You can't push a rope
text: 拉着一条毛巾的一角，它能在桌面上平平地跟着走；从后面推，它马上就皱成一团。这就是缝纫机用送布牙“拖”布、而不“推”布的原因。
Pull a towel by one corner and it slides flat across the table; push it from behind and it bunches up at once. That is why a sewing machine drags the cloth with the feed dog rather than pushing it.

title: 四个方向：更省、更聪明、更少人、不缝
Four directions: more economical, smarter, fewer people, no sewing
points: 哪些趋势已经成熟、正在普及？哪些卡在物理和经济门槛上？哪些在改变“缝”本身？
Which trends are mature and spreading? Which are stuck at physical and economic thresholds? Which change 'sewing' itself?
每列越往下越新、越不成熟
Further down each column means newer and less mature
“更少人”一列最受布料的“软”和投资回收约束
The 'fewer people' column is most constrained by fabric softness and payback
narration: 这一讲往前看：今后十年缝纫机和缝制车间会变成什么样？与其背新名词，不如问三个问题：哪些趋势已经成熟、正在普及；哪些还卡在基本的物理和经济门槛上，比宣传慢得多；哪些在改变“缝”本身。图上分四列：更省、更聪明、更少人、不缝，每列越往下越新、越不成熟。我们会在“更少人”这一列上用力最多，因为它最受两件事约束：布太软，和投资能不能收回来。

This lecture looks ahead: what will sewing machines and floors look like in ten years? Rather than memorising buzzwords, ask three questions: which trends are mature and spreading; which are stuck at basic physical and economic thresholds and moving far slower than the publicity; and which change sewing itself. The chart has four columns — more economical, smarter, fewer people, no sewing — and the lower an item in a column, the newer and less mature it is. We will spend most effort on 'fewer people', because two things constrain it: cloth is too soft, and the investment has to pay back.

title: 伺服直驱的节电账
The energy account of direct-drive servos
points: 离合器电机通电就空转；伺服只在需要时转，直驱省掉皮带
A clutch motor idles whenever switched on; a servo turns only when needed, and direct drive drops the belt
改造案例：约 450 W → 250 W，节电约 45%，4 个月回本
Retrofit case: about 450 W → 250 W, about 45% saving, 4-month payback
500 台 × 3550 h：约 80 万 → 44 万 kWh，省 35.5 万 kWh，约 200 t CO₂
500 machines × 3550 h: about 800 000 → 440 000 kWh, saving 355 000 kWh, about 200 t CO₂
slides.formula: E_{\text{年}}=m\,h\,\bar P,\qquad \Delta E=m\,h\,(\bar P_{\text{离合器}}-\bar P_{\text{伺服}})
narration: 最成熟的趋势是省电。第 13 章讲过，老式离合器电机一通电就以额定转速空转，踩脚踏才通过离合器带动机头；伺服电机只在缝的时候转。一份公开案例把 20 台平缝机换成伺服，平均功率从约 450 瓦降到 250 瓦，节电约 45%，4 个月收回投资。我们放大到 500 台的工厂，每台每年开机 3550 小时：离合器约 80 万度，伺服约 44 万度，一年省 35.5 万度，按 0.57 的排放因子约 200 吨二氧化碳。注意，空等时间越多，换伺服省得越多。

The most mature trend is saving electricity. As Chapter 13 explained, an old clutch motor idles at rated speed as soon as it is on and drives the head through a clutch only when the pedal is pressed; a servo turns only while sewing. A published case converted 20 lockstitch machines to servos: average power fell from about 450 W to 250 W, about 45% saving, paid back in 4 months. Scale it to a 500-machine factory running 3550 hours a year each: about 800 000 kWh with clutch motors, 440 000 with servos, saving 355 000 kWh, about 200 tonnes of CO₂ at 0.57. Note: the more time machines sit idle, the more the servo saves.

title: 软件定义的缝纫机
The software-defined sewing machine
points: 电子送布、电子张力、电子压脚：针距、张力、压力变成程序里的数
Electronic feed, tension and presser foot: stitch length, tension and pressure become numbers in a program
可按缝纫段切换、按布料自动调整、从网络下发
They can switch by segment, adapt to fabric, or be downloaded over the network
机构变简单，软件变复杂：机构工程师要懂控制，控制工程师要懂线迹
Mechanisms get simpler, software more complex: mechanism engineers must know control, control engineers stitch formation
narration: 直驱只是第一步。第 14 章的电子送布、电子张力、电子压脚，把原来由凸轮、连杆、弹簧决定的动作交给了步进电机和程序。针距、张力、压脚压力都变成程序里的一个数，可以按缝纫段切换，按布料自动调整，也可以从网络下发。同一个机头装上不同的程序，就是不同的机器。这对设计者是新要求：机构工程师要懂控制，控制工程师要懂线迹形成；而第 18 章的电控可靠性、第 23 章的机械精度，在这种机器上一样重要，不会因为软件多了就不要了。

Direct drive is only step one. The electronic feed, tension and presser foot of Chapter 14 hand motions once set by cams, links and springs to stepper motors and programs. Stitch length, tension and presser-foot pressure each become a number that can switch by sewing segment, adapt automatically to the fabric, or be sent over the network. The same head with a different program is a different machine. That is a new demand on designers: mechanism engineers must understand control, and control engineers must understand stitch formation. The control-box reliability of Chapter 18 and the mechanical accuracy of Chapter 23 still matter just as much on such machines.

title: 从单机自动到成套智联
From single-machine automation to connected complete lines
points: 花样机、模板机让一台机器走完一个花样；自动单元把上料、缝制、堆叠连起来
Pattern sewers and template machines complete a pattern alone; automatic units link loading, sewing and stacking
吊挂连成单件流，联网和数字孪生让管理者看到每台机器、每件衣服
Hangers link stations into one-piece flow; networking and digital twins show every machine and every garment
难点在系统集成：通信格式、准确的工艺数据、会用的人
The difficulty is integration: common data formats, accurate process data, people who can use it
narration: 把前面各章串起来：花样机、模板机让一台机器自己走完一个花样，自动开袋机、贴袋机把上料、缝制、堆叠连成一个单元，吊挂再把工位连成单件流；联网和数字孪生让管理者在屏幕上看到每台机器的状态、每件衣服的位置；第 28 章的线平衡变成了吊挂里的自动派活。这就是设备商说的成套智联。这条路已经比较成熟，难点不在单台设备，而在系统集成：不同厂家能不能互通，工艺数据准不准，人会不会用。回报主要是缩短周期、减少在制品。

String the earlier chapters together: pattern and template machines let one machine finish a pattern; automatic pocket machines link loading, sewing and stacking into a unit; hangers link stations into one-piece flow; networking and digital twins show every machine's state and every garment's position on screen; and the line balancing of Chapter 28 becomes live dispatching in the hanger system. That is what equipment makers call connected complete lines. The path is fairly mature; the difficulty is not individual machines but integration — can different makers' equipment talk, is the process data accurate, can people use it. The payoff is mainly shorter throughput time and less work in progress.

title: 布有多软：弯曲刚度
How soft is cloth? Bending rigidity
points: 悬臂法：布条伸出台边，垂到规定角度时的伸出长度即弯曲长度 c
Cantilever test: the overhang at which a strip droops to a set angle is the bending length c
B（μN·m）= 9.8×10⁻⁶ × 克重（g/m²）× c³（mm）
B (μN·m) = 9.8×10⁻⁶ × mass per area (g/m²) × c³ (mm)
汗布约 4、府绸约 9、毛料约 38、牛仔布约 170 μN·m；1 mm 钢板约 16.7 N·m
Jersey about 4, poplin 9, wool 38, denim 170 μN·m; 1 mm steel about 16.7 N·m
narration: 汽车车身机器人焊，电路板机器贴片，衣服为什么还是人缝？答案要从布的“软”说起。衡量抵抗弯曲的能力用弯曲刚度 B，每单位宽度。测布常用悬臂法：把布条水平伸出台边，看它伸出多长时垂到规定角度，这个长度叫弯曲长度 c，B 就等于单位面积重力乘 c 的三次方。代数字：衬衫府绸 120 克、20 毫米，约 9 微牛米；1 毫米钢板约 16.7 牛米。衬衫布不到钢板的百万分之一。刚度和 c 的三次方成正比，这一点后面要用。

Car bodies are welded by robots and circuit boards placed by machines — so why are clothes still sewn by people? The answer starts with softness. Resistance to bending is measured by bending rigidity B, per unit width. Fabric is usually tested by the cantilever method: push a strip over the table edge and see how far it overhangs before drooping to a set angle; that length is the bending length c, and B equals weight per unit area times c cubed. With numbers: shirt poplin, 120 grams and 20 millimetres, about 9 micronewton-metres; a 1 mm steel sheet about 16.7 newton-metres. Shirt cloth is less than a millionth of the steel. Rigidity goes with c cubed — keep that in mind.

title: 立不住：自重下的大变形悬臂
It cannot stand: large-deflection cantilever under its own weight
points: 伸出 2c 时弦角约 42°（悬臂法定义，皮尔斯近似 41.5°）
At an overhang of 2c the chord drops about 42° (the cantilever-test definition; Peirce uses 41.5°)
伸出 10 cm：汗布、府绸弦角 82°–86°，牛仔布 65°，钢板和卡纸几乎不动
Overhang 10 cm: jersey and poplin 82°–86°, denim 65°; steel and card hardly move
竖着夹住能立起约 2c：衬衫布约 4 cm（格林希尔公式）
Clamped vertically it stands about 2c: shirt cloth about 4 cm (Greenhill's formula)
narration: 软到什么程度？把几种材料从夹持边水平伸出 10 厘米，看自重下的形状。钢板、卡纸几乎纹丝不动；面料伸出两倍弯曲长度时，夹持点到末端的连线就已经下倾约 42 度，伸出 10 厘米时针织布和衬衫布几乎垂直挂着，弦角 82 到 86 度，最硬的牛仔布也有 65 度。所以机器人一拿起布，形状就变了，拿的位置稍有不同形状又不一样。反过来竖着夹，它能立住的高度约是 2c，衬衫布只有 4 厘米左右。注意形状只取决于伸出长度和 c 的比值。

How soft? Let several materials project 10 cm from a clamp and look at their shape under their own weight. Steel and card barely move. A fabric projecting twice its bending length already has its chord dropping about 42 degrees; at 10 cm the knit and shirt cloth hang almost vertically, chord angles of 82 to 86 degrees, and even the stiffest, denim, reaches 65. So the moment a robot lifts cloth, its shape changes, and a slightly different grip gives a different shape again. Clamp it vertically instead and it can stand only about 2c — shirt cloth about 4 cm. Note that the shape depends only on the ratio of overhang to c.

title: 推不动：推布失稳
It cannot be pushed: push buckling
points: 一端夹住、另一端可侧移的布条，推力到 F_cr 就拱起（压杆失稳，取下限）
A strip clamped at one end, the other free to move sideways, arches at F_cr (column buckling, lower bound)
府绸 5 cm × 30 cm：F_cr ≈ 2.8 mN，自重约 18 mN，还不到六分之一
Poplin 5 cm × 30 cm: F_cr ≈ 2.8 mN, own weight about 18 mN — under one sixth
推力超过自重要 c > 0.74L：推 5 cm 要 c > 37 mm，比牛仔布还硬；所以缝纫机靠送布牙“拖”
Push above weight needs c > 0.74L: 37 mm for 5 cm, stiffer than denim — so machines drag with the feed dog
narration: 更麻烦的是布几乎不能推。一条沿推的方向长 L、宽 b 的布条，一端夹住往前推，另一端可以侧移，推力到 π² B b 除以 4L² 就会拱起来，和压杆失稳一个道理。代入衬衫布：长 5 厘米、宽 30 厘米，临界力只有约 2.8 毫牛，而这条布自重约 18 毫牛，推力还不到自重的六分之一。要让推力超过自重，弯曲长度要大于 0.74 倍的 L，推 5 厘米要 37 毫米以上，比牛仔布还硬。所以缝纫机从不推布：针板托、压脚压、送布牙从下面一齿一齿地拖。

Worse, cloth can hardly be pushed. A strip of length L in the push direction and width b, clamped at one end and pushed, with the other end free to move sideways, arches when the push reaches pi squared B b over 4 L squared — column buckling again. For shirt cloth 5 cm long and 30 cm wide, the critical force is only about 2.8 millinewtons, while the strip weighs about 18 — less than a sixth. For the push to exceed the weight the bending length must exceed 0.74 L; for 5 cm that is over 37 mm, stiffer than denim. So sewing machines never push: the throat plate supports, the foot presses, and the feed dog drags the cloth tooth by tooth from below.

title: 机器人怎么拿布
How robots handle cloth
points: 改进抓取：针刺式、真空吸附、静电吸附、冷冻黏附
Better grasping: needle, vacuum, electroadhesive and cryo grippers
改变布：浸水溶性树脂暂时变硬，缝完洗掉（未见规模化应用）
Change the cloth: stiffen it temporarily with water-soluble resin, wash out after sewing (no large-scale use seen)
不让布离开台面：视觉实时识别，在机头前不断纠偏
Keep the cloth on the table: vision recognises it and corrects its path at the head continuously
narration: 研究者和企业想了很多办法，大致三类。第一类改进抓取：针刺式夹爪把细针斜插进布里钩住，适合厚而蓬松的布；真空吸附要大流量，因为布透气，从一叠里只取最上面一层尤其难；还有静电吸附、冷冻黏附。第二类改变布：把布浸上水溶性树脂，暂时变得像板材，用普通机械臂搬运缝制，缝完再洗掉，但公开资料里还没看到规模化应用。第三类不让布离开台面：用相机实时识别布片，在过机头时不断纠偏，像熟练工的手。综述的结论是离稳定的工业应用还有距离。

Researchers and companies have tried many approaches, in three families. First, better grasping: needle grippers drive fine needles obliquely into thick, bulky cloth; vacuum needs large air flow because cloth is porous, and taking only the top ply from a stack is especially hard; there are also electroadhesive and freezing grippers. Second, change the cloth: soak it in water-soluble resin so it behaves like sheet, handle and sew it with ordinary robot arms, then wash the resin out — but no large-scale use appears in public sources. Third, keep the cloth on the table: cameras recognise the piece and keep correcting its path through the head, like a skilled hand. Reviews conclude stable industrial use is still some way off.

title: 一个没有落地的计划：先核对数字
A plan that never happened: cross-check the numbers
points: 2017 年宣称：21 条线，每条 22 秒一件，每天 80 万件
Claimed in 2017: 21 lines, one T-shirt every 22 s per line, 800 000 a day
86400 ÷ 22 ≈ 3900 件/线·天，21 条约 8.2 万件，差近十倍；按每线每年 125 万件约 7.2 万件/天
86 400 ÷ 22 ≈ 3900 per line-day, about 82 000 for 21 lines — nearly ten times short; 1.25 million per line-year gives about 72 000 a day
2025 年报道：全天候高速、合格率 98% 以上仍很难，换棉布批次、缸色要重新标定
2025 report: 24/7 high speed with yield above 98% still hard; new cotton batches and dye lots need recalibration
narration: 讲一个公开案例。2017 年，一家缝制机器人公司和一家服装企业宣布在美国建厂，21 条全自动 T 恤线，每 22 秒一件，每天 80 万件。我们自己算：一天 86400 秒除以 22，每条线约 3900 件，21 条约 8.2 万件，离 80 万差了将近十倍；另一份介绍说每线每年 125 万件，折合每天约 7.2 万件。数字自己就对不上。后来计划没有实现，2025 年的报道说，要做到全天候高速、合格率高于 98% 仍然很难，换棉布批次、换缸色都要停机标定。读新技术报道，先核对数字。

A public case. In 2017 a sewing-robot company and an apparel firm announced a US factory with 21 fully automatic T-shirt lines, one shirt every 22 seconds, 800 000 a day. Do the sum: 86 400 seconds a day divided by 22 is about 3900 per line, about 82 000 for 21 lines — nearly ten times short of 800 000; another description gave 1.25 million per line per year, about 72 000 a day. The numbers do not agree with each other. The plan was never realised; a 2025 report said running 24/7 at speed with yield above 98% was still very hard, and new cotton batches or dye lots meant stopping to recalibrate. With new-technology reports, check the numbers first.

title: 人形机器人进入车间：2026 年的进展
Humanoid robots on the floor: progress in 2026
points: 签约部署 2000 台定制人形机器人：搬运、叠放、卸料、领子和口袋对位，单动作 10 s 内，精度约 2 mm
Agreement to deploy 2000 custom humanoids: handling, stacking, unloading, collar and pocket alignment; under 10 s per motion, about 2 mm accuracy
另一家：分离布片成功率约 97%，送料缝制约 98% 达标，回收期约 18 个月
Another firm: ply separation about 97% successful, about 98% of fed sewing up to standard, payback about 18 months
“单个工序做得好，还跑不通整条流程”；拿布像“夹豆腐”
'Good at single operations, cannot yet run the whole flow'; handling cloth is like 'picking up tofu'
narration: 再看最新进展。2026 年，国内一家机器人企业和缝制设备企业签约，向服装厂部署 2000 台定制人形机器人，做布料搬运、叠放、卸料，以及领子、口袋对位，单个动作 10 秒以内，对位精度约 2 毫米。新华社报道的另一家给了更具体的数字：分离布片成功率约 97%，送料缝制约 98% 达标，回收期约 18 个月。但负责人也说，它能把单个工序做好，却还不能在没人参与的情况下跑通整条流程，拿布就像夹豆腐。这句话怎么用数学说清楚？看下一页。

Now the latest progress. In 2026 a Chinese robotics firm and a sewing-equipment maker signed an agreement to deploy 2000 customised humanoid robots in garment factories for fabric handling, stacking, unloading and collar and pocket alignment, under 10 seconds per motion with about 2 mm accuracy. A Xinhua report on another firm gave sharper numbers: ply separation about 97% successful, about 98% of the sewing it fed up to standard, payback about 18 months. But its head also said the robot can do one operation well yet cannot run a whole flow without people — handling cloth is like picking up tofu. How do we state that mathematically? Next slide.

title: 单步成功率的 n 次方
The nth power of the single-step success rate
points: n 个动作、每步成功率 p、各步独立：无人完成率 P = pⁿ
n motions, success p each, independent: unattended completion P = pⁿ
0.97¹⁰ ≈ 74%：每 4 件约 1 件要人处理；要 90% 需每步约 99%
0.97¹⁰ ≈ 74%: about one in four needs a person; 90% needs about 99% per step
每步 8 s、失败处理 30 s：97% 时每小时干预约 12 次，99% 约 4 次，99.9% 不到 0.5 次
8 s per step, 30 s per failure: about 12 interventions/h at 97%, 4 at 99%, under 0.5 at 99.9%
slides.formula: P = p^{\,n},\qquad \bar f=\frac{n(1-p)}{p},\qquad T=\frac{n\,t_{\rm step}}{p}+\bar f\,t_{\rm fix}
narration: 一件衣片从料堆到缝好，机器人要依次完成分离、提起、铺平、对位、上料等 n 个动作，每步成功率 p，各步独立，整条流程无人完成的概率就是 p 的 n 次方。每步 97%、10 步，0.97 的十次方约 74%，每 4 件就有 1 件要人来管。要 90% 无人完成，每步要 0.9 开十次方，约 99%。再算干预：每件期望失败次数是 n 乘 1 减 p 再除以 p，每步 8 秒、失败处理 30 秒，97% 时每小时约 12 次，99% 约 4 次。单步过 99%，旁边才能不站人。

To take a panel from the stack to a finished seam, the robot performs n motions in turn — separate, lift, smooth, align, load — each succeeding with probability p; if independent, the chance of finishing with no human is p to the n. At 97% and 10 steps, 0.97 to the tenth is about 74%: one piece in four needs a person. For 90% unattended, each step needs the tenth root of 0.9, about 99%. Now interventions: expected failures per piece are n times one minus p over p; with 8 s per step and 30 s per failure, that is about 12 an hour at 97% and about 4 at 99%. Only above 99% per step can nobody stand beside it.

title: 算账：回收期
Doing the sums: payback
points: 价格 25 万元、维护 10%/年、顶替每班一人、两班、0.5 元/分：年省人工 14.4 万元
Price 250 000 yuan, maintenance 10%/yr, replaces one operator per shift, two shifts, 0.5 yuan/min: 144 000 yuan labour saved a year
扣除处理失败人工和维护：97% 时约 29 个月，99% 时约 26 个月；三班约 18 个月
After failure handling and maintenance: about 29 months at 97%, 26 at 99%; about 18 on three shifts
班次和价格比成功率影响更大；“顶替一人”本身是乐观假设（模型每小时约 39 件）
Shifts and price matter more than success rate; 'replaces one operator' is optimistic (the model makes about 39 pieces/h)
slides.formula: \text{回收期}=\frac{12\times\text{价格}}{\text{年省人工}-\text{处理失败人工}-0.1\times\text{价格}}\ (\text{月})
narration: 再算账。机器人 25 万元，年维护费 10%，假设顶替每班一名操作工，两班，人工每分钟 0.5 元：一年省人工 14.4 万元。扣掉处理失败的人工和 2.5 万维护费，每步 97% 时回收期约 29 个月，99% 时约 26 个月；改三班降到 18 个月左右，正好和报道接近，但这些输入都是算例，不能互相印证。在这组数里，班次和价格比成功率影响还大，机器人每天用得越久越划算。还要提醒：顶替一名操作工是乐观假设，模型里每小时约 39 件，没和熟练工比速度。

Now the money. A 250 000-yuan robot, 10% annual maintenance, assumed to replace one operator per shift, two shifts, labour at 0.5 yuan a minute: 144 000 yuan saved a year. Subtract the labour for handling failures and 25 000 maintenance, and payback is about 29 months at 97% per step and about 26 at 99%; three shifts bring it to around 18 months, close to the reported figure — but these inputs are examples and cannot confirm each other. In this set, shifts and price matter more than success rate: the more hours a day, the better. One more caution: replacing one operator is optimistic; the model makes about 39 pieces an hour, not compared with a skilled operator.

title: 还有哪些门槛
What other thresholds remain
points: 泛化：换面料、换款式就要重新学——布料性能千差万别
Generalisation: a new fabric or style means relearning — fabric properties vary hugely
感知：反光和灰尘干扰视觉；耐久和散热：两三班连续运转
Perception: reflections and dust disturb vision; durability and heat: two or three shifts non-stop
没有统一接口和安全标准；人形能用现有工位，专用上料机构或协作臂可能更简单可靠
No common interface or safety standards; humanoids reuse existing stations, but dedicated loaders or cobots may be simpler and more reliable
narration: 报道里列的问题和前面的分析一一对应。一是泛化，换一种面料、换一个款式就要重新学，这正是布料性能千差万别的结果；二是感知，反光和灰尘会干扰视觉；三是耐久和散热，车间一天两三班，第 18 章讲的可靠性问题照样存在；四是没有统一接口和安全标准，机器人和缝纫机、吊挂怎样通信，人和机器人怎样在同一车间里保证安全，都在摸索。人形的好处是能直接用现有工位，代价是双腿双臂双手的复杂。很多固定工序上，专用上料机构或协作机械臂可能更简单可靠。

The problems in the reports match the analysis point for point. One, generalisation: a different fabric or style means relearning — the direct result of fabric variety. Two, perception: reflections and dust disturb vision. Three, durability and heat: floors run two or three shifts, and the reliability issues of Chapter 18 still apply. Four, no common interface or safety standards: how robots talk to sewing machines and hangers, and how people and robots share a floor safely, are still being worked out. The humanoid's advantage is using existing stations unchanged; the price is the complexity of legs, arms and hands. For many fixed operations a dedicated loader or collaborative arm may be simpler and more reliable.

title: 不缝的衣服
Garments without sewing
points: 全成型编织：整件下机，省裁剪套口缝合，但只适用针织、上机时间长
Whole-garment knitting: complete off the machine, no cutting, linking or seaming — knits only, long machine times
超声波焊接：局部熔融合成纤维，平整无针眼可防水；纯棉焊不上
Ultrasonic welding: locally melts synthetic fibres, flat, no needle holes, waterproof; pure cotton cannot be welded
热熔胶带粘合：对纤维要求低，但温度、压力、时间要严控；缝线接缝仍最通用
Hot-melt tape bonding: less fibre-sensitive, but temperature, pressure and time must be tight; sewn seams remain the most versatile
narration: 还有一条路是绕开缝纫。第 17、29 章讲过全成型编织，毛衫整件下机，省掉裁剪、套口和缝合，但只适用于针织，上机时间长、编程难。运动服、内衣、户外服装上，另两种方式越来越多：超声波焊接用高频振动让合成纤维在接缝处局部熔融，平整、没针眼、能防水，但纯棉焊不上；热熔胶带粘合用热压把胶膜熔进两层布之间，对纤维要求低一些，但温度、压力、时间要严格控制，和西服粘衬是一类工艺。这些不会让缝纫机消失，但设备设计者要熟悉的工艺范围更宽了。

Another route bypasses sewing. Chapters 17 and 29 covered whole-garment knitting: the sweater comes off complete, with no cutting, linking or seaming — but only for knits, with long machine times and hard programming. In sportswear, underwear and outdoor clothing two other methods are spreading. Ultrasonic welding melts synthetic fibres locally at the seam by high-frequency vibration — flat, no needle holes, waterproof — but pure cotton cannot be welded. Hot-melt tape bonding melts an adhesive film between two plies under heat and pressure; it is less fussy about fibre, but temperature, pressure and time must be tightly controlled, like fusing suit interlinings. Sewing machines will not disappear, but designers need a wider range of processes.

title: 数码印花与绿色制造
Digital printing and green manufacturing
points: 一件 T 恤加工耗电约 0.105 kWh，其中缝制约 0.098 kWh，约 60 g CO₂；大头在纺纱、织布、染整
Processing a T-shirt uses about 0.105 kWh, sewing about 0.098 kWh, about 60 g CO₂; the bulk is in spinning, weaving, dyeing
数码印花对比圆网：用水少 36%、电少 35%、化学品少 28%、废水少 41%、布损少 70%
Digital vs rotary-screen: 36% less water, 35% less electricity, 28% fewer chemicals, 41% less wastewater, 70% less fabric waste
换花型几乎无准备损耗，适合按需生产：少做卖不掉的衣服
Almost no set-up waste per design change, suited to on-demand production: make fewer unsold garments
narration: 最后说绿色。服装的环境负担大头在纺纱、织布和染整，缝制本身不多：一件 T 恤从铺布到熨烫约 0.105 度电，其中缝制约 0.098 度，约 60 克二氧化碳。车间能做的是伺服省电、少油无油旋梭、降噪。染整里一个重要变化是数码印花，像喷墨打印机一样直接把染料喷到布上，不用制网版。秘鲁的对比研究显示，用水少 36%，用电少 35%，废水少 41%，布料损耗少 70%。更重要的是换花型几乎没有损耗，适合按需生产，少做卖不掉的衣服，这可能是服装业最大的绿色。

Finally, green manufacturing. Most of apparel's environmental burden lies in spinning, weaving and dyeing; sewing uses little: a T-shirt from spreading to pressing takes about 0.105 kWh, sewing about 0.098, roughly 60 grams of CO₂. The floor can still save power with servos, use low-oil or oil-free hooks and cut noise. A key change in dyeing is digital printing, jetting dye straight onto cloth like an inkjet printer with no screens. A Peruvian comparison found 36% less water, 35% less electricity, 41% less wastewater and 70% less fabric waste. More importantly, changing designs costs almost nothing, suiting on-demand production — making fewer unsold clothes may be the industry's biggest green gain.

summary: 伺服直驱是最成熟的趋势：年节电 = 台数 × 开机小时 × 功率差，空等时间越多越划算，通常几个月回本。
Direct-drive servos are the most mature trend: annual saving = machines × running hours × power difference; the more idle time, the better; payback is usually a few months.
布几乎没有弯曲刚度（B = w c³）：立不住（约 2c）、推不动（F_cr = π²Bb/4L²），所以缝纫机靠送布牙拖布，可行的自动化是让布贴着台面走。

Cloth has almost no bending rigidity (B = w c³): it cannot stand (about 2c) or be pushed (F_cr = π²Bb/4L²), so machines drag it with the feed dog, and workable automation keeps the cloth on the table.
多步流程的无人完成率是 pⁿ：单步 97% 的 10 步流程只有 74%，单步要过 99% 机器人旁边才能不站人。
A multi-step flow completes unattended with probability pⁿ: a 10-step flow at 97% per step manages only 74%; each step must exceed 99% before nobody needs to stand by.
机器人回收期受班次和价格影响最大；读新技术报道要先拿数字互相核对。
Robot payback depends most on shifts and price; cross-check the numbers in any new-technology report.
焊接、粘合、全成型和数码印花在特定品类上替代或改变缝制与染整，缝纫机仍是最通用的连接方式。
Welding, bonding, whole-garment knitting and digital printing replace or change sewing and dyeing in certain categories, but the sewing machine remains the most versatile joining method.

title: 软面料与机器人
Soft fabric and robots
goal: 用重力下的大变形悬臂模型观察面料下垂，算出弯曲刚度、弦角和推弯布条所需的力。
Use the large-deflection cantilever model to see fabric droop and compute bending rigidity, chord angle and the force that buckles a pushed strip.
调机器人流程参数，看无人完成率、每小时干预次数和回收期怎样变化。
Vary robot-flow parameters and see how unattended completion, interventions per hour and payback change.
算出全厂由离合器电机改伺服的年节电量和减排量。
Calculate a factory's annual electricity saving and emission reduction from switching clutch motors to servos.
theory: 弯曲刚度 B（μN·m）= 9.8×10⁻⁶ × 克重（g/m²）× c³（mm），即 B = w c³；下垂形状只取决于伸出长度与弯曲长度之比 L/c。
Bending rigidity B (μN·m) = 9.8×10⁻⁶ × mass per area (g/m²) × c³ (mm), i.e. B = w c³; the droop shape depends only on L/c.
一端夹住、另一端可侧移的布条在 F = π²Bb/(4L²) 时失稳，实验页取 L = 5 cm 固定，与伸出长度无关。
A strip clamped at one end and free to move sideways at the other buckles at F = π²Bb/(4L²); the page fixes L = 5 cm, independent of the overhang.
流程：无人完成率 P = pⁿ；每件期望失败次数 n(1 − p)/p；节拍 = n·t_step/p + 失败次数 × t_fix；年省人工 = 班次 × 工资 × 60 × 8 × 300。
Flow: unattended completion P = pⁿ; expected failures per piece n(1 − p)/p; cycle = n·t_step/p + failures × t_fix; labour saved = shifts × wage × 60 × 8 × 300.
节电：年耗电 = 台数 × 开机小时 × 平均功率；默认离合器 0.45 kW、伺服 0.25 kW，排放因子 0.57 kg CO₂/kWh。
Energy: annual use = machines × running hours × average power; defaults clutch 0.45 kW, servo 0.25 kW, emission factor 0.57 kg CO₂/kWh.
steps: 打开实验页第①页“面料有多软”，在“材料”下拉框依次选四种面料、卡纸和钢板，伸出长度 10 cm，记录每种材料的弯曲刚度、弦角和推弯 5 cm 布条所需的力。

Open page ① 'How soft is fabric', choose each of the four fabrics, card and steel in the Material list with a 10 cm overhang, and record bending rigidity, chord angle and the force to buckle a 5 cm strip.
选“衬衫府绸”，只拖动“克重”滑块，观察下垂形状和弦角是否变化；再只拖“弯曲长度 c”，比较两者的作用。
Choose shirt poplin and move only the mass slider: does the droop shape or chord angle change? Then move only the bending length c and compare.
任务①：保持伸出 10 cm，增大弯曲长度直到弦角 ≤ 10°，记下所需的 c 和弯曲刚度，算出它是衬衫府绸的多少倍。
Task ①: keep the 10 cm overhang and increase the bending length until the chord angle is ≤ 10°; note c and the rigidity, and work out how many times poplin's it is.
任务②：调“推的布条宽度 b”，看推力与自重之比是否改变；再增大弯曲长度，直到推弯布条的力超过它自己的重量，记下此时的 c。
Task ②: change the strip width b and see whether the push-to-weight ratio changes; then increase the bending length until the buckling force exceeds the strip's weight, and note c.
切到第②页“机器人流程的可靠性与回收期”，默认 10 步、97%：记录无人完成率、每小时干预次数、每小时产量和回收期。
Go to page ② 'Reliability and payback of robot flows'; with the default 10 steps and 97%, record unattended completion, interventions per hour, output per hour and payback.
任务③：步数固定 10，逐步提高“单步成功率”，找出无人完成率达到 90% 的最小值。
Task ③: with 10 steps, raise the single-step success rate gradually and find the minimum for 90% unattended completion.
任务④：保持两班、单步 ≤ 97%、步数 ≥ 10，调机器人价格、人工或每步动作时间，使回收期 ≤ 24 个月；再把班次改成 3，看回收期变化。
Task ④: keeping two shifts, success ≤ 97% and at least 10 steps, adjust price, labour cost or time per step to get payback ≤ 24 months; then set shifts to 3 and watch payback.
切到第③页“直驱的节电账”，用默认值记录全厂年耗电、年节电和减排；任务⑤：保持默认功率，调每台开机时间，使每台年节电达到 500 kWh（误差 20 kWh 内）。

Go to page ③ 'The direct-drive energy account', record annual use, saving and emission reduction with defaults; Task ⑤: keep the default powers and adjust running hours until each machine saves 500 kWh a year (within 20 kWh).

questions: 为什么只改克重时下垂形状不变？由 B = w c³ 说明形状由什么决定。
Why does the droop shape not change when only the mass changes? Use B = w c³ to say what determines the shape.
改变布条宽度 b 能不能让布“推得动”？为什么推力和自重的比只取决于 c 和 L？
Can changing the strip width b make cloth pushable? Why does the ratio of push to weight depend only on c and L?
任务④中，哪个参数对回收期影响最大？这对机器人在工厂里的使用方式意味着什么？
In Task ④, which parameter affects payback most? What does that imply for how robots should be used in a factory?
任务⑤找到的开机时间与默认的 3550 h 相比如何？为什么空等时间越多，换伺服越划算？
How does the running time found in Task ⑤ compare with the default 3550 h? Why does more idle time make the servo retrofit pay better?

title: 一份自动化提案的工程评估
Engineering appraisal of an automation proposal
tasks: （计算）一家工厂有 300 台平缝机，每台每年开机 3000 h，离合器电机平均功率 0.45 kW、伺服 0.25 kW，电价 0.7 元/kWh，每台改造费用 500 元。求年节电量、年省电费、投资回收期和按 0.57 kg CO₂/kWh 的年减排量。

(Calculation) A factory has 300 lockstitch machines running 3000 h a year each; clutch motors average 0.45 kW, servos 0.25 kW; electricity is 0.7 yuan/kWh and the retrofit costs 500 yuan per machine. Find the annual saving in kWh and yuan, the payback and the annual CO₂ reduction at 0.57 kg/kWh.
（计算）一种面料克重 200 g/m²，悬臂法弯曲长度 25 mm。求弯曲刚度；一条沿推的方向长 5 cm、宽 20 cm 的布条一端夹住往前推（另一端可侧移），推力达到多少会拱起？与布条自重比较，并说明夹持点离缝合点近一半时临界力怎样变化。

(Calculation) A fabric of 200 g/m² has a cantilever bending length of 25 mm. Find its bending rigidity; a strip 5 cm long in the push direction and 20 cm wide is clamped at one end and pushed (other end free to move sideways): at what force does it arch? Compare with its weight, and say how the critical force changes if the clamp is moved to half the distance.
（评估）供应商提出一套 8 步的机器人上料方案，单步成功率 98%、每步 8 s，失败人工处理 30 s，价格 25 万元，两班制，人工 0.5 元/分。算出无人完成率、每小时干预次数和回收期；若要整条流程 95% 无人完成，单步至少要多少？写出你还要向供应商索取的数据（至少包括节拍、换款重新调试时间、对不同面料的成功率），并给出是否试点的建议。

(Appraisal) A vendor proposes an 8-step robot loading scheme: 98% per step, 8 s per step, 30 s manual handling per failure, price 250 000 yuan, two shifts, labour 0.5 yuan/min. Compute unattended completion, interventions per hour and payback; what single-step rate would give 95% unattended completion? List the further data you would ask the vendor for (at least cycle time, re-adjustment time after a style change, success rates on different fabrics) and recommend whether to pilot it.
deliverable: 计算过程（可附 Python 脚本），虚拟实验 30-1 三页各一张截图，以及不超过 2 页的评估意见。
Calculations (a Python script may be attached), one screenshot from each of the three pages of Virtual lab 30-1, and an appraisal of no more than 2 pages.
rubric: 节电、电费、回收期和减排计算正确（25 分）
Energy, cost, payback and emission calculations correct (25 points)
弯曲刚度、推布失稳力与自重比较正确，能说明临界力与 L² 成反比（25 分）
Bending rigidity, buckling force and weight comparison correct, with the inverse-square dependence on L explained (25 points)
机器人流程的 pⁿ、干预次数、回收期和所需单步成功率计算正确（30 分）
Robot-flow pⁿ, interventions, payback and required single-step rate correct (30 points)
索取的数据和试点建议有依据（20 分）
Requested data and pilot recommendation well justified (20 points)

text: 离合器电机改成伺服直驱后节电的主要原因是什么？
What is the main reason a servo direct drive saves electricity compared with a clutch motor?
离合器电机通电后一直以额定转速空转，伺服只在需要时转动
The clutch motor idles at rated speed whenever switched on; the servo turns only when needed
伺服电机的额定功率总比离合器电机小一半
A servo's rated power is always half the clutch motor's
伺服电机让缝纫机转速更低
The servo makes the sewing machine run slower
直驱省掉了针杆和挑线机构
Direct drive eliminates the needle bar and take-up mechanism

feedback: 节电量取决于空等时间占比：空等越多，离合器电机浪费越多，换伺服越省。
The saving depends on the share of idle time: the more idle time, the more the clutch motor wastes and the more the servo saves.

text: 一家工厂有 300 台平缝机，每台每年开机 3000 h，离合器电机平均 0.45 kW，伺服 0.25 kW。年节电多少 kWh？
A factory has 300 lockstitch machines running 3000 h a year; clutch motors average 0.45 kW, servos 0.25 kW. What is the annual saving in kWh?
一种面料克重 200 g/m²，悬臂法测得弯曲长度 25 mm。按 B（μN·m）= 9.8×10⁻⁶ × 克重 × c³，弯曲刚度是多少 μN·m？
A fabric weighs 200 g/m² with a cantilever bending length of 25 mm. Using B (μN·m) = 9.8×10⁻⁶ × mass × c³, what is its bending rigidity in μN·m?
两种面料克重相同，弯曲长度 A 是 B 的 2 倍。A 的弯曲刚度是 B 的几倍？
Two fabrics have the same mass per area; A's bending length is twice B's. How many times B's bending rigidity is A's?
8 倍
8 times
2 倍
2 times
4 倍
4 times
16 times

feedback: B = w c³，克重相同时刚度与弯曲长度的三次方成正比，2³ = 8。
B = w c³; with equal mass, rigidity scales with the cube of bending length, 2³ = 8.

text: 同一种面料，只把克重加倍、弯曲长度不变，从夹持边伸出 10 cm 时的下垂形状和弦角不变。
For the same fabric, doubling only the mass per area while keeping the bending length unchanged leaves the droop shape and chord angle at a 10 cm overhang unchanged.
feedback: 刚度和自重都与克重成正比，形状只取决于伸出长度与弯曲长度之比 L/c。
Both rigidity and weight scale with mass per area, so the shape depends only on L/c.

text: 一条布条一端夹住往前推，另一端可侧移。把推的方向上的悬空长度 L 减到一半，失稳推力怎样变化？
A strip is clamped at one end and pushed, the other end free to move sideways. If the free length L in the push direction is halved, how does the buckling force change?
变为原来的 4 倍
It becomes 4 times as large
变为原来的 2 倍
It doubles
不变
It is unchanged
变为原来的 16 倍
It becomes 16 times as large

feedback: F_cr = π²Bb/(4L²) 与 L² 成反比，L 减半则力增大 4 倍。16 倍是两端都夹住与一端夹住相比的倍数。
F_cr = π²Bb/(4L²) is inversely proportional to L², so halving L quadruples it. The factor 16 compares both ends clamped with one end clamped.

text: 一个机器人流程有 8 步，单步成功率 98%，各步独立。整条流程无人完成的概率是多少（%）？
A robot flow has 8 steps with 98% success each, independently. What is the probability (%) of completing the whole flow unattended?
报道称每条线 22 秒做一件 T 恤。一天 24 小时不停，21 条线一天最多能做多少件？
A report says each line makes one T-shirt every 22 s. Running 24 hours a day, how many can 21 lines make per day at most?
feedback: 86 400 ÷ 22 ≈ 3927 per line, × 21 ≈ 82 473, nearly ten times short of the claimed 800 000.

text: 关于机器人上料的回收期模型（价格 25 万元，两班，0.5 元/分，10 步、每步 8 s），下列哪些说法正确？
For the robot-loading payback model (250 000 yuan, two shifts, 0.5 yuan/min, 10 steps of 8 s), which statements are correct?
每步 97% 时回收期约 29 个月，改三班约 18 个月
At 97% per step payback is about 29 months, about 18 on three shifts
在这组算例中，班次对回收期的影响比单步成功率从 97% 提到 99% 还大
In this example, shifts affect payback more than raising success from 97% to 99%
“顶替一名操作工”是乐观假设，因为模型没有和熟练工的速度比较
'Replaces one operator' is optimistic because the model was not compared with a skilled operator's speed
回收期约 18 个月与报道一致，说明算例输入得到了验证
The 18-month figure matching the report validates the example inputs

feedback: 97% 两班约 28.7 个月、99% 约 26.4 个月、三班约 17.7 个月；教材特别指出算例输入不能与报道互相印证。
Two shifts: about 28.7 months at 97% and 26.4 at 99%; three shifts about 17.7. The book stresses the example inputs cannot confirm the report.

text: 超声波焊接适合下列哪种面料的接缝？
For which fabric is ultrasonic welding of seams suitable?
热塑性合成纤维含量高的运动面料
Sportswear fabric with a high thermoplastic synthetic-fibre content
纯棉府绸
Pure cotton poplin
羊毛西服料
Wool suiting
全成型毛衫衣片
Whole-garment knitted sweater panels

feedback: 超声波焊接靠局部熔融合成纤维，要求热塑性纤维含量较高，纯棉焊不上。
Ultrasonic welding melts synthetic fibres locally and needs a high thermoplastic content; pure cotton cannot be welded.

text: 一家工厂有 200 台平缝机，每台每年开机 4000 h，离合器电机平均 0.45 kW，伺服 0.25 kW，电价 0.7 元/kWh，每台改造 600 元。投资回收期约多少个月？
A factory has 200 lockstitch machines running 4000 h a year; clutch 0.45 kW, servo 0.25 kW average; electricity 0.7 yuan/kWh; retrofit 600 yuan per machine. What is the payback in months?
feedback: Saving 200 × 4000 × 0.2 = 160 000 kWh, 112 000 yuan; investment 120 000 yuan; payback 120 000 ÷ 112 000 × 12 ≈ 12.9 months.

text: 牛仔布克重 400 g/m²、弯曲长度 35 mm。一条沿推的方向长 5 cm、宽 20 cm 的布条一端夹住往前推（另一端可侧移），失稳推力是多少 mN？

Denim weighs 400 g/m² with a bending length of 35 mm. A strip 5 cm long in the push direction and 20 cm wide is clamped at one end and pushed (other end free to move sideways). What is the buckling force in mN?
feedback: B = 9.8×10⁻⁶ × 400 × 35³ ≈ 168 μN·m; F = π² × 168×10⁻⁶ × 0.2 ÷ (4 × 0.05²) ≈ 33.2 mN, still below the strip's weight of about 39.2 mN (c = 35 mm < 0.74L = 37 mm).

text: 一个 8 步的机器人流程要求整条流程 95% 无人完成，单步成功率至少要多少（%）？
An 8-step robot flow must complete unattended 95% of the time. What minimum single-step success rate (%) is required?
为什么缝纫机用送布牙从下面“拖”布，而不是从后面“推”布？
Why does a sewing machine drag the cloth with the feed dog from below instead of pushing it from behind?
布的弯曲刚度极小，推力远小于自重时就会失稳拱起；拖的时候布受拉，不会失稳
Cloth's bending rigidity is tiny, so it buckles under a push far smaller than its own weight; when dragged it is in tension and cannot buckle
推布需要的电机功率太大
Pushing would need too much motor power
推布会让针距变大
Pushing would lengthen the stitch
布的摩擦系数太小，推不住
The cloth's friction coefficient is too small to push

feedback: F_cr = π²Bb/(4L²)：衬衫布 5 cm 长时只有约 2.8 mN，不到自重的六分之一；受拉的布没有失稳问题，所以针板托、压脚压、送布牙拖。
F_cr = π²Bb/(4L²): about 2.8 mN for a 5 cm shirt strip, under a sixth of its weight; cloth in tension cannot buckle, so the plate supports, the foot presses and the feed dog drags.

text: 评估一项人形机器人进入缝制车间的方案时，下列哪些判断符合教材的分析？
When appraising a plan to bring humanoid robots onto a sewing floor, which judgements agree with the book's analysis?
要同时看单步成功率和整条流程的成功率
Look at both single-step and whole-flow success rates
要问换一种面料、换一个款式是否需要重新调试
Ask whether a new fabric or style requires readjustment
布一直贴着台面走的方案比把布拿在空中的方案可靠得多
A scheme keeping the cloth on the table is far more reliable than one holding it in the air
只要单步成功率达到 97%，机器人旁边就可以不站人
Once each step reaches 97%, nobody needs to stand beside the robot

feedback: 10 步流程 97% 时每小时约 12 次干预，要 99% 以上才能无人值守；泛化和布在哪里固定是教材强调的关键问题。
At 97% a 10-step flow needs about 12 interventions an hour; over 99% is needed for unattended work. Generalisation and how the cloth is held are the key questions the book stresses.

key: 伺服节电账；弯曲刚度 B = w c³ 与推布失稳 F_cr = π²Bb/(4L²)；多步流程成功率 pⁿ 与回收期。
The servo energy account; bending rigidity B = w c³ and push buckling F_cr = π²Bb/(4L²); multi-step success pⁿ and payback.
difficult: 把压杆失稳迁移到布条推送并理解“推不动”的物理含义；理解 pⁿ 与干预次数、回收期之间的联系。
Transferring column buckling to pushing a strip of cloth and grasping what 'cannot be pushed' means physically; linking pⁿ to interventions and payback.

phase: 导入：机器人上料值不值
Opening: is robot loading worth it?
content: 展示四个方向图，提出车间问题：供应商说单步 97%，10 步流程、25 万元的机器人值不值？
Show the four-direction chart and pose the question: is a 250 000-yuan, 10-step robot at 97% per step worth it?
伺服节电账课堂计算；软件定义的缝纫机；成套智联与系统集成的难点。
In-class servo energy calculation; the software-defined machine; connected lines and integration difficulties.
弯曲刚度、悬臂下垂、立住高度、推布失稳公式与算例；机器人拿布的三类办法；报道数字核对练习。
Bending rigidity, cantilever droop, standing height, push-buckling formula and examples; three families of robot handling; cross-checking a report's numbers.
学生分组完成第①–③页的 5 个任务并填记录表。
Groups complete the 5 tasks on pages ①–③ and fill in the record table.

phase: 人形机器人门槛与回收期
content: pⁿ 推导、干预次数、回收期算账；回到导入问题给出答案；讨论其余门槛。
Derive pⁿ, interventions and payback; answer the opening question; discuss remaining thresholds.

phase: 不缝的衣服与绿色制造、小结
content: 焊接、粘合、全成型的适用范围；数码印花对比数据；小结并布置作业。
Where welding, bonding and whole-garment knitting apply; digital-printing comparison; summary and assignment.

homework: 完成作业“一份自动化提案的工程评估”，并完成教材第 30 章习题 4、5。
Complete the assignment 'Engineering appraisal of an automation proposal', plus Chapter 30 exercises 4 and 5.
